cd @SESSION@/box/work; mkdir -p src
cat > src/minigit.csproj <<'EOF'
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <LangVersion>14</LangVersion>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <AssemblyName>minigit</AssemblyName>
    <InvariantGlobalization>true</InvariantGlobalization>
    <TieredPGO>true</TieredPGO>
    <TieredCompilationQuickJitForLoops>true</TieredCompilationQuickJitForLoops>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>
EOF
cat > src/Program.cs <<'EOF'
using System.Text;

const string Root = ".minigit";
string objectsDir = Path.Combine(Root, "objects");
string commitsDir = Path.Combine(Root, "commits");
string indexPath = Path.Combine(Root, "index");
string headPath = Path.Combine(Root, "HEAD");

if (args.Length == 0)
{
    Console.WriteLine("Usage: minigit <command>");
    return 1;
}

switch (args[0])
{
    case "init": return Init();
    case "add": return args.Length < 2 ? Usage("add <file>") : Add(args[1]);
    case "commit":
        return args.Length < 3 || args[1] != "-m" ? Usage("commit -m \"<message>\"") : Commit(args[2]);
    case "log": return Log();
    default:
        Console.WriteLine($"Unknown command: {args[0]}");
        return 1;
}

static int Usage(string s)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Usage: minigit {s}");
    return 1;
}

int Init()
{
    if (Directory.Exists(Root))
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Repository already initialized");
        return 0;
    }
    Directory.CreateDirectory(objectsDir);
    Directory.CreateDirectory(commitsDir);
    File.WriteAllText(indexPath, "");
    File.WriteAllText(headPath, "");
    return 0;
}

int Add(string file)
{
    if (!File.Exists(file))
    {
        Console.WriteLine("File not found");
        return 1;
    }
    byte[] data = File.ReadAllBytes(file);
    string hash = MiniHash(data);
    string blobPath = Path.Combine(objectsDir, hash);
    if (!File.Exists(blobPath))
        File.WriteAllBytes(blobPath, data);

    var entries = ReadIndex();
    if (!entries.Contains(file))
        File.AppendAllText(indexPath, file + "\n");
    return 0;
}

int Commit(string message)
{
    var entries = ReadIndex();
    if (entries.Count == 0)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Nothing to commit");
        return 1;
    }

    string head = ReadHead();
    var files = entries.Distinct().OrderBy(f => f, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();
    var sb = new StringBuilder();
    sb.Append($"parent: {(head.Length == 0 ? "NONE" : head)}\n");
    sb.Append($"timestamp: {DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}\n");
    sb.Append($"message: {message}\n");
    sb.Append("files:\n");
    foreach (var f in files)
    {
        // Hash the content as of commit time; ensure the blob exists.
        byte[] data = File.Exists(f) ? File.ReadAllBytes(f) : [];
        string blob = MiniHash(data);
        string blobPath = Path.Combine(objectsDir, blob);
        if (!File.Exists(blobPath))
            File.WriteAllBytes(blobPath, data);
        sb.Append($"{f} {blob}\n");
    }

    string content = sb.ToString();
    string commitHash = MiniHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(content));
    File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(commitsDir, commitHash), content);
    File.WriteAllText(headPath, commitHash);
    File.WriteAllText(indexPath, "");
    Console.WriteLine($"Committed {commitHash}");
    return 0;
}

int Log()
{
    string current = ReadHead();
    if (current.Length == 0)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("No commits");
        return 0;
    }

    var output = new StringBuilder();
    bool first = true;
    while (current.Length > 0 && current != "NONE")
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(commitsDir, current);
        if (!File.Exists(path))
            break;
        string parent = "NONE", timestamp = "", message = "";
        foreach (var line in File.ReadAllLines(path))
        {
            if (line.StartsWith("parent: ")) parent = line["parent: ".Length..];
            else if (line.StartsWith("timestamp: ")) timestamp = line["timestamp: ".Length..];
            else if (line.StartsWith("message: ")) message = line["message: ".Length..];
            else if (line == "files:") break;
        }
        if (!first) output.Append('\n');
        first = false;
        output.Append($"commit {current}\nDate: {timestamp}\nMessage: {message}\n");
        current = parent;
    }
    Console.Write(output.ToString());
    return 0;
}

List<string> ReadIndex() =>
    File.Exists(indexPath)
        ? File.ReadAllLines(indexPath).Where(l => l.Length > 0).ToList()
        : [];

string ReadHead() => File.Exists(headPath) ? File.ReadAllText(headPath).Trim() : "";

static string MiniHash(byte[] data)
{
    ulong h = 1469598103934665603UL;
    foreach (byte b in data)
    {
        h ^= b;
        unchecked { h *= 1099511628211UL; }
    }
    return h.ToString("x16");
}
EOF
cat > Makefile <<'EOF'
BUILD_DIR := build
SRC := src/Program.cs src/minigit.csproj

all: minigit

$(BUILD_DIR)/minigit.dll: $(SRC)
	DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 dotnet publish src/minigit.csproj -c Release -o $(BUILD_DIR) --nologo -v quiet

minigit: $(BUILD_DIR)/minigit.dll
	printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nDIR="$$(cd "$$(dirname "$${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"\nexec "$$DIR/$(BUILD_DIR)/minigit" "$$@"\n' > minigit
	chmod +x minigit

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) minigit src/bin src/obj

.PHONY: all clean
EOF
bash test-v1.sh
